title: Choosing a delivery service
passage:
M1: I need to send this signed contract to our branch office. It must arrive before nine tomorrow morning. I thought ordinary next-day delivery would be enough.
F1: That service guarantees delivery only by the end of the working day. Let me show you our current options on this card.
M1: I see. The office is closed this evening, so there's no benefit in delivering it today. Which service meets the morning deadline?
F1: The one with an eight-thirty guarantee. We'll collect the envelope from you before five today.
M1: All right. Please use that one. Can the branch manager receive a tracking message?
F1: Yes. Write her email address on this form, and I'll add it to the booking.
passageZh:
男：我需要把這份簽好的合約寄到分公司，明早九點前一定要到。我以為一般隔日送達就夠了。
女：那個服務只保證下個工作日結束前送達。請看這張卡片上的選項。
男：了解。辦公室今晚沒開，所以今天送也沒有幫助。哪種服務趕得上早上的期限？
女：保證八點半前送達的那種。我們今天五點前向你收件。
男：好，就用那個。分公司經理可以收到追蹤訊息嗎？
女：可以，請在表格上寫她的電子郵件，我會加入訂單。
